title: Puppy reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'>
  <!-- Puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#E8A94C'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#F2C46D'/>
  <!-- Puppy head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='#D4953A'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='44' r='12' fill='#E8B05A'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='36' rx='8' ry='13' transform='rotate(-20 30 36)' fill='#8B5E2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='36' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(-20 30 36)' fill='#A8753E'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='36' rx='8' ry='13' transform='rotate(20 70 36)' fill='#8B5E2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='36' rx='5' ry='9' transform='rotate(20 70 36)' fill='#A8753E'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='46' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#4A2A1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='3' ry='1.5' fill='#6B4030'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 57 Q50 62 54 57' fill='none' stroke='#6B4030' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#FF7B8A'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='4' fill='#F0A0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='4' fill='#F0A0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <path d='M22 72 L44 66 L44 90 L22 96 Z' fill='#4A7BC8'/>
  <path d='M56 66 L78 72 L78 96 L56 90 Z' fill='#4A7BC8'/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <path d='M24 73 L44 67.5 L44 88 L24 93.5 Z' fill='#FFF8E8'/>
  <path d='M56 67.5 L76 73 L76 93.5 L56 88 Z' fill='#FFF8E8'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x='44' y='66' width='12' height='26' fill='#3A62A8'/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1='28' y1='76' x2='40' y2='73' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='80' x2='40' y2='77' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='84' x2='40' y2='81' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='88' x2='40' y2='85' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='73' x2='72' y2='76' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='77' x2='72' y2='80' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='81' x2='72' y2='84' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='85' x2='72' y2='88' stroke='#D4C8A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Book edge highlights -->
  <path d='M22 72 L44 66' stroke='#6B9BE0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 66 L78 72' stroke='#6B9BE0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M22 96 L44 90' stroke='#6B9BE0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 90 L78 96' stroke='#6B9BE0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='91' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#D4953A'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E8B05A'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='91' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#D4953A'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E8B05A'/>
  <!-- Paw toe lines -->
  <line x1='30' y1='90' x2='30' y2='93' stroke='#B87A2E' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='90' x2='33' y2='93' stroke='#B87A2E' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='90' x2='66' y2='93' stroke='#B87A2E' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='69' y1='90' x2='69' y2='93' stroke='#B87A2E' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M72 82 Q86 76 84 66 Q83 60 78 62' fill='none' stroke='#D4953A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 82 Q86 76 84 66 Q83 60 78 62' fill='none' stroke='#E8B05A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyebrows -->
  <path d='M38 40 Q42 37 46 40' fill='none' stroke='#A8753E' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 40 Q58 37 62 40' fill='none' stroke='#A8753E' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
